execution_notes.process_restarts: The original model process failed at 8B warmup. Two waiting replacement processes were stopped to load code fixes and a shorter supported lock polling interval; they had not acquired the GPU lock or loaded models. Completed feature extraction was preserved.
execution_notes.deviation: The five successful configurations were completed across two GPU-owning processes instead of one uninterrupted process. No completed model extraction or Ollama formatting generation was repeated.

test_integrity_deviation.event: Two unguarded full-suite runs (45 tests initially, 60 in the captured later run) invoked existing WS1 tests, including DomainTests.test_scan_all_official_lines_both_executors, which reads the official length-test file. The worker did not inspect those tests before executing the suite. The number of file opens was not instrumented.
test_integrity_deviation.mitigation: v2/probe/safe_discovery.py blocks Path.open for the forbidden file and turns that read attempt into a skipped test. v2/probe/test_logged.py now uses the guarded route; original and guarded logs are preserved separately.
test_integrity_deviation.scope: No other workstream test source or official data was edited.
